name: Quantum Technology Laboratories
description: Quantum Technology Laboratories (qtlabs) is a Vienna-based company specializing in free-space and satellite-based quantum communication systems. Building on over 20 years of pioneering research including world-record satellite quantum downlinks, qtlabs develops space-based quantum key distribution technology to enable global quantum-secure communication networks.
